scripts.text:
[Fabian]
Man... When you travel all around the world, you'll hear of some crazy things.
scripts.translation:
[法比安]
哎...周游世界，总会听到些离奇的事。

scripts.text:
[Fabian]
Once, I heard that there are Cards which contain the power of monsters. If someone happens to get their hands on a card, they'll be able to use that monster's power.
scripts.translation:
[法比安]
有一次，我听说有蕴含魔物力量的卡片。如果有人弄到这种卡片，就能使用那只魔物的力量。

scripts.text:
[Fabian]
I'm guessing it's some sort of fad or scam, where they make you collect all the cards or whatever. I mean, how can a card really hold the power of a monster?!
scripts.translation:
[法比安]
我猜是赶时髦，或者是骗局，哄你把卡片都收齐之类的。
卡片怎么可能真的装得下魔物的力量？！

scripts.text:
[Fabian]
Seriously...
scripts.translation:
[法比安]
真是的...

scripts.text:
[Steiner]
Oh...!
Welcome to Alberta,
young adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[斯坦纳]
哦...！欢迎来到艾尔贝塔，年轻的冒险者！

scripts.text:
[Steiner]
Pardon me if I seem distracted. I'm milling about, trying to make a plan. You see, I hear that there is a store in Geffen that sells armor that is resistant to magic.
scripts.translation:
[斯坦纳]
抱歉，我有点心不在焉，正琢磨一个计划。
听说吉芬有家店，卖能抵御魔法的护甲。

scripts.text:
[Steiner]
If I buy a lot of them in bulk, and then resell them here for a higher price...
scripts.translation:
[斯坦纳]
如果我大量进货，然后在这里以更高的价格转售...

scripts.text:
[Chad]
People say the legendary weapon Gungnir never misses its target. I wonder if it's possibly true...
scripts.translation:
[查德]
据说传说中的刚尼尔长矛百发百中，不知道是不是真的...

scripts.text:
[Chad]
People also say that babies are assembled by the storks before delivery, girls dig guys who act like jerks, and that Santa Claus exists! But only in Lutie.
scripts.translation:
[查德]
大家还说，婴儿是鹳鸟组装好再送来的，女孩偏偏喜欢坏小子，还有圣诞老人真的存在！
不过，只在姜饼城。

scripts.text:
[Chad]
I wonder...
If any of that
is possibly
true...
scripts.translation:
[查德]
真不知道...这些事里，有没有哪件是真的...

scripts.text:
[Deagle]
^666666*Hiccup*^000000
Wh-what are you
staring at? Get lost!!
Say nothing.
scripts.translation: 保持沉默

scripts.text: Leave him alone.
scripts.translation: 别管他

scripts.text:
[Deagle]
Hahahaha ^666666*hiccup*^000000... You've got some nerve. I may look worthless now, but I used to be a sailor on the 'Going Mary.'
scripts.translation:
[迪格尔]
哈哈哈哈哈 ^666666*打嗝*^000000... 你胆子不小啊。我现在看起来可能一无是处，但我以前可是“玛丽号”上的水手。

scripts.text: Never heard of it.
scripts.translation: 没听说过

scripts.text: Really? No kidding!
scripts.translation: 真的吗？天哪！

scripts.text:
[Deagle]
Never heard of it?! Everybody knows th'notorious pirate ship 'Going Mary!' ^666666*Hiccup~*^000000
scripts.translation:
[迪格尔]
没听说过？！谁不知道那艘臭名昭著的海盗船“玛丽号”啊！^666666*打嗝~*^000000

scripts.text:
[Deagle]
Ah~ The ol'days. If only... If only we hadn't run into that STORM...^666666*hiccup*^000000
scripts.translation:
[迪格尔]
啊~ 怀念过去。要是... 要是我们没遇到那场暴风雨就好了...^666666*打嗝*^000000

scripts.text:
[Deagle]
AH~ Captain. I miss our cap'n more than anything... No foe survived before cap'n's sword.
scripts.translation:
[迪格尔]
啊~船长。我最想念的就是船长...
他的剑下从不留活口。

scripts.text:
[Deagle]
That's right! NOBODY meshes with the crew of the 'Going Mary!' And nobody can beat out cap'n in a sword fight!
scripts.translation:
[迪格尔]
没错！没人能跟“玛丽号”的船员匹敌！也没人能在剑术上胜过船长！

scripts.text:
[Deagle]
CAPTAIN~!!! ^666666*HICCUP~*^000000 He would swing his sword like this, then... THEN!!

[Deagle]
The bastard the captain was fighting, and anyone of his friends near him, were surrounded in flame!
scripts.translation:
[迪格尔]
和船长交手的混蛋，连同他身边的同伙，全都被火焰吞没了！

scripts.text:
[Deagle]
Man, that sword must have had some sort of mysterious power, or the captain was just that good...!
scripts.translation:
[迪格尔]
天哪，那把剑一定有什么神秘的力量，或者船长就是那么厉害...！

scripts.text:
[Deagle]
Phew~~ ^666666*Sob* *Sob...*^000000 God, I miss everyone! Now I'm depressed! Please, go away now.
scripts.translation:
[迪格尔]
呼~~^666666*抽泣* *抽泣...*^000000
天哪，我好想大家！心情糟透了！求你，走吧。

scripts.text:
[Deagle]
That's right!
Go AWAY~
scripts.translation:
[迪格尔]
没错！
快滚~

scripts.text:
[Shakir]
We Merchants have our own negotiating skill when we sell goods. This skill can get us more money than when other people sell goods.
scripts.translation:
[沙基尔]
我们商人卖东西时，有专门的议价技能，能比别人卖出更高的价钱。

scripts.text:
[Shakir]
We Merchants can
open roadside stands
to do business.
scripts.translation:
[沙基尔]
我们商人还能在路边摆摊做生意。

scripts.text:
[Shakir]
It's more than just yelling 'You'll have to give more money please!' You need to have charisma, and master rhetoric!
scripts.translation:
[沙基尔]
这可不是嚷嚷“再多给点钱”就行的。
你得有说服力，还得掌握谈判技巧！

scripts.text:
[Shakir]
We can get up to 24 % more zeny with this incredible skill. But remember to train hard to acquire it!!
scripts.translation:
[沙基尔]
靠这个厉害的技能，卖价最高能多出24%的Zeny。
不过，要刻苦练习才能掌握！

scripts.text:
[Shakir]
With the Discount skill, we can buy goods really cheap from the stores in towns and load them into the cart we rent.
scripts.translation:
[沙基尔]
有了低价买进技能，就能从城镇商店低价进货，再装进租来的手推车。

scripts.text:
[Shakir]
Then afterwards, we can travel anywhere, and sells our goods to make a profit!
scripts.translation:
[沙基尔]
然后走到哪里，都能卖货赚钱！

scripts.text:
[Shakir]
This way, business is more convenient and safe. Don't fall asleep, although it's too easy to do that.
scripts.translation:
[沙基尔]
这样，生意就更方便、更安全了。虽然很容易睡着，但别打瞌睡。

scripts.text:
[Sonya]
Hey, you know, this one time I was walking through the forest and I saw this little green stem moving around.
scripts.translation:
[索尼娅]
嘿，有次我经过森林，看见一根绿色的小茎在动。

scripts.text:
[Sonya]
You know those lazy looking bears that live in the forest on the way to Payon?
scripts.translation:
[索尼娅]
通往斐扬的森林里，那些看起来懒洋洋的熊，你知道吧？

scripts.text:
[Sonya]
I once saw a pack of wolves take on one of those huge, lazy bears!
scripts.translation:
[索尼娅]
我曾经看到一群狼围攻其中一只巨大的懒熊！

scripts.text: [Sonya]
scripts.translation: [索尼娅]

scripts.text:
[Sonya]
I went to see what it was and when I went to touch it. The stem actually slapped my hand!
scripts.translation:
[索尼娅]
我凑过去看，刚想伸手碰，那根茎竟然拍了我的手！

scripts.text:
[Sonya]
It startled me, so I jumped back a bit and then I realized it wasn't a stem, but a very small animal.
scripts.translation:
[索尼娅]
吓得我往后一跳，才发现那不是茎，而是一只小小的动物。

scripts.text:
[Sonya]
I was lucky I didn't upset it. Even the smallest animal can be dangerous if angered.
scripts.translation:
[索尼娅]
幸好我没有惹怒它。即使是最小的动物，如果被激怒也会很危险。

scripts.text:
[Sonya]
Just for fun, I threw a rock at it and all of sudden it rushed at me! I was sooooo scared, I started to run away, then BAM!!!
scripts.translation:
[索尼娅]
我觉得好玩，就朝它扔了块石头，结果它突然冲了过来！
我吓得拔腿就跑，然后，砰！

scripts.text:
[Sonya]
It ran into a low tree branch and knocked itself out! I swear, I'll never provoke an animal for fun again!
scripts.translation:
[索尼娅]
它撞上了低矮的树枝，把自己撞晕了！我发誓，我再也不会为了好玩去挑衅动物了！

scripts.text:
[Sonya]
Wolves are much more cooperative than they may seem. If one of them is attacked, then any nearby wolves will run to help.
scripts.translation:
[索尼娅]
狼群比看起来要团结得多。如果其中一只受到攻击，附近的狼都会赶过来支援。

scripts.text:
[Sonya]
I'd think twice if you ever want to fight one when others of its kind are around. Be careful: don't get ganged up on!
scripts.translation:
[索尼娅]
想攻击一只狼时，要是附近还有其他狼，可得三思。
小心，别被围攻了！

scripts.text:
[Grandmother Alma]
Some time ago,
a derelict ship
drifted into
Alberta harbour.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔玛奶奶]
前些日子，一艘废弃的船漂进了艾尔贝塔港。

scripts.text:
[Grandmother Alma]
Hoping to save any survivors, some of the townspeople ventured into the ship. However, they all ran out terrified, saying that corpses were walking around inside the ship.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔玛奶奶]
为了寻找幸存者，一些镇民登上了那艘船。然而，他们全都惊恐地逃了出来，说船里有尸体在走动。

scripts.text:
[Grandmother Alma]
The ship was also packed with dangerous marine organisms, and they couldn't get inside, even if they wanted to.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔玛奶奶]
船里还挤满了危险的海洋生物，想再进去都做不到。

scripts.text:
[Grandmother Alma]
We couldn't do anything about that ominous looking ship, and just left it as it was. Nowadays, exploration teams try to enter that ship and wipe out its monsters.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔玛奶奶]
我们对那艘阴森森的船无能为力，只能任由它停在那里。如今，探险队试图进入那艘船，清除里面的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Grandmother Alma]
So it might be a good experience for a young person like yourself to be a recruit. But, it's still not worth risking your life if you're not strong enough.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔玛奶奶]
你这样的年轻人去参加探险队，或许能积累不错的经验。
不过，本事不够的话，就别拿命去冒险了。

scripts.text:
[Fisk]
Ahoy mate,
where'd ya
wanna go?
scripts.translation:
[菲斯克]
嘿，伙计，
你想去哪儿？

scripts.text: Sunken Ship -> 250 zeny.
scripts.translation: 沉船 -> 250 Zeny

scripts.text: Izlude Marina -> 500 zeny.
scripts.translation: 依斯鲁得岛码头 -> 500 Zeny

scripts.text: Never mind.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Fisk]
Hey now, don't try to cheat me! I said 250 zeny!
scripts.translation:
[菲斯克]
嘿，别想占我便宜！我说了是250 Zeny！

scripts.text:
[Fisk]
Ain't no way yer getting there without the 500 zeny first!
scripts.translation:
[菲斯克]
没给500 Zeny，你别想过去！

scripts.text:
[Fisk]
Alright...
Landlubber.
scripts.translation:
[菲斯克]
好吧...
旱鸭子。

scripts.text:
[Fisk]
So you wanna head back to the mainland in Alberta, eh?
scripts.translation:
[菲斯克]
想回艾尔贝塔的陆地上，是吧？

scripts.text: Yes please.
scripts.translation: 请送我回去

scripts.text: I changed my mind.
scripts.translation: 我改变主意了

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Good day~
Would you like
to join the
exploration team
of the Sunken Ship?
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
你好~想加入沉船探险队吗？

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Oh! Before you join, I must warn you. If you're not that strong, you may not want to go.
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
哦！报名之前，先提醒你一句。
实力不够的话，最好别去。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
So, want
to sign up?
The admission
fee is only
200 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
怎么样，要报名吗？报名费只要200 Zeny。

scripts.text: Sign me up!
scripts.translation: 我要报名！

scripts.text: Uh, no thanks.
scripts.translation: 不了，谢谢

scripts.text:
[Paul]
It seems you don't have the money, my friend. But please come back when you're able to pay.
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
看来你身上没钱啊，朋友。不过等你有钱了，欢迎随时回来。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Alright, well...
I'll be around
if you change
your mind.
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
好吧...改变主意的话，我就在这里。

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
Wait a moment!!
You have brought too many things!
You cannot accept any more items!
Please reduce the amount of items,
then come see me again.
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
等等！你带的东西太多，装不下更多物品了！
先减少物品，再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
The hell are you doing here?
There is nothing you can get for free on this ship, if you want somethin', work for it!!
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
你在这干什么？
这艘船上没有免费的东西，想要什么就自己干活！！

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
Hmm.. you want to exchange Jellopies for Red Potions or some Carrots eh? Well.. which one?
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
嗯...想拿杰勒比结晶换红色药水，还是胡萝卜？
选哪个？

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
Hmm, so why don't you bring me 10 Jellopies and I will give 1 potion. How's that sound?
Or if that's too hard for your pansy ass, 3 Jellopies for 1 Carrot.
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
嗯，那你给我10个杰勒比结晶，我给你1瓶药水。怎么样？
如果你觉得这对你这种胆小鬼来说太难了，那就3个杰勒比结晶换1根胡萝卜。

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
If you're interested in my offer, get me the stuff I mentioned.
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
如果你对我的提议感兴趣，就把我提到的东西拿来。

scripts.text: Red Potions please.
scripts.translation: 换红色药水

scripts.text: Carrots please.
scripts.translation: 换胡萝卜

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
Alright...
Let's see
what'cha got...
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
好吧...看看你带了什么...

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
Hey! Weren't you listening? I said 10 Jellopies for 1 Red Potion.. are ya deaf?
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
嘿！没听见吗？10个杰勒比结晶换1瓶红色药水...你耳朵聋了？

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
Hmm, not bad...
How many potions
do you want to get?
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
嗯，不错...
你想换多少瓶药水？

scripts.text: As many as I can, please.
scripts.translation: 能换多少就换多少

scripts.text: I want this many.
scripts.translation: 我要这么多

scripts.text: Never mind, I like my jellopy.
scripts.translation: 算了，留着杰勒比结晶

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
I'm not giving you more than 100 at a time so don't bother, OK? If you don't want any, just say '0'.
Right now, the most you can get is {0} but remember, 100 at most, you want to break my back?.
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
一次最多给你100瓶，别想要更多。不换就输入“0”。
你现在最多能换{0}瓶，不过一次上限是100瓶，想累断我的腰啊？

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
Much obliged, come again anytime.
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
多谢，欢迎随时再来。

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
Hey, what'd I say? 100 at a time at most, you're trying to kill me aren't you!
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
嘿，我说什么来着？一次最多100瓶，想累死我啊！

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
Hmm, it looks like you don't have enough. Go get more Jellopies if you want anything else from me.
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
嗯，杰勒比结晶不够。
想换东西，就再去弄些来。

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
[Phelix]
There you go! As I promised. Don't go suckin' them all down at once.
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
[菲利克斯]
给你！说到做到，别一口气全喝光了。

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
No problem,
see you next time.
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
没问题，
下次见。

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
There you go! As I promised. Don't go suckin' them all down at once.
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
给你！说到做到，别一口气全喝光了。

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
Alright, let's see what ya got...
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
好了，让我看看你有什么...

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
Hmm, look pansy ass, I said 3 Jellopies for 1 Carrot.. got it?
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
嗯，你这娘娘腔，我说了3个杰勒比结晶换1根胡萝卜...听明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
Not too bad pansy...
How many do you want?
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
还不错嘛，娘娘腔...
你想要多少？

scripts.text: As many as I can get, please
scripts.translation: 能换多少就换多少

scripts.text: I want this many.
scripts.translation: 我要这么多

scripts.text: Never mind, I like my jellopy.
scripts.translation: 算了，留着杰勒比结晶

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
Right I'm not giving you more than 100 at a time so don't bother, okay? If you don't want any, just say '0'.
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
听好，一次最多给你100根，别想要更多。
不换就输入“0”。

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
Alright then, see you next time.
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
好的，下次见。

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
Hey pansy ass, I said 100 at most, no more than that! I'm not going to break my back for the likes of you!
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
嘿，你这娘娘腔，我说了最多100个，不能再多了！我才不会为了你们这种人累断腰！

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
Seems you don't have enough. Go get some more if you want anything else.
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
看来杰勒比结晶不够。
还想换东西，就再去弄些来。

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
[Phelix]
There you go~! As I promised. Try not to stuff yer face.
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
[菲利克斯]
给你~！说到做到，别吃撑了。

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
Catch'ya later.
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
回头见。

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
There you go~! As I promised. Try not to stuff yer face.
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
给你~！说到做到，别吃撑了。
